General/Typical Procedure: Reduction of α-Keto Aldoxime O-Ethers with Borane/Oxazaborolidine; General Procedure : To a solution of the appropriate amino alcohol (2 mmol) in THF (10 mL) was added 10 M BMS (borane-methyl sulfide complex) (0.2 mL, 2 mmol) and the mixture was stirred at r.t. for 1 h. THF (5 mL) and the rest of BMS (0.8 mL, 8 mmol) were added and the mixture was stirred for another 10 min. The mixture was cooled to 0 °C and α-keto aldoxime ether (2 mmol) in THF (15 mL) was added in 2.5 h using a syringe pump. The mixture was stirred at 0 °C for 10 min, at r.t. for 30 min, and refluxed for 18 h. After cooling to r.t., aq 3 M HCl (12 mL) was added slowly and the mixture was allowed to stir for 5 h. THF was removed on a rotary evaporator; then EtOAc (30 mL) and NaCl (5 g) were added to the residue, and the mixture was basified with aq 10% NaOH to pH 12 and stirred for 5 min. The organic layer was separated and the residue was extracted with EtOAc (5 x 15 mL). The combined organic extracts were dried (MgSO4). The solvent was removed and the product was isolated by flash chromatography on silica gel (CH2Cl2-MeOH, 90:10).
